name: Chromatic Dispersion Volumetric Display
definition: A method for realizing a solid-state volumetric display in real space by using the chromatic dispersion properties of a diffractive lens to image a series of planar patterns from a projector. Each image plane's position is defined by a distinct wavelength of light from a narrowband polychromatic source.
summary: Chromatic Dispersion Volumetric Display projects a solid-state 3D volume in free space using a diffractive lens to focus distinct wavelengths onto separate planes, eliminating moving parts.
